chunks: Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"By Allah, tamattuʿ is superior, and through it the Qur'an was revealed, and the sunnah has continued upon it until the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: superior or more excellent in ruling and merit
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the normative prophetic and Imamic tradition continuing upon this ruling
key_terms.الْقُرْآنُ: the Qur'an, cited here as the revealed basis for this practice
key_terms.الْمُتْعَةُ: tamattuʿ; the form of hajj being described as superior
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, indicating the ruling's lasting validity

ai.seo_question: Why is hajj al-tamattuʿ described as superior in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the superiority of tamattuʿ in the context of hajj and affirms that it is rooted in both the Qur'an and the sunnah. It presents the ruling as enduring and valid until the Day of Resurrection.
